versions.name: Hawk Mountain Scout Reservation

features.note: Aquatics run at both the pool and the lakefront.
Open swim daily, plus an early-morning Polar Bear dip.
Range and target activities; no individual ranges are named.
A STEM building near the centre of camp.
Two dining halls, Miller and Willits.
Two-person canvas tents on raised wooden platforms.
Latrines in each site, plus centralised shower and restroom buildings.
Each campsite has its own pavilion.
On the ground floor of the Miller Dining Hall.
A campfire circle used for the opening and closing campfires.
Youth who cannot attend with their own troop can register as provisional campers.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident camp near New Ringgold, Pennsylvania, in Schuylkill County, offering a first-year camper program, aquatics with pool and lakefront, range and target activities, outdoor skills, conservation, handicraft, climbing, and zip-lining.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). That page summarises program areas without naming individual ranges, so two parent codes are kept; the reservation's own Scouts BSA leaders guide, linked from it, was read as the second source for facilities and programme structure.
